falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern relied on a higher low formation; a break below this level confirms a lower low structure, invalidating the bottoming thesis and suggesting continuation of the prior downtrend rather than reversal

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 39 indicates elevated but controlled fear; sustained VIX above 35 signals panic escalation inconsistent with a bottoming pattern and instead indicates capitulation-driven trend continuation or new leg down

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve inverts by more than -50 basis points (spread below -0.50%)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion contradicts the recovery/bottom narrative embedded in the pattern; it signals intensifying recession pricing that would override the 80% pattern match and force reclassification to a delayed-cycle or false-bottom regime

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
